classification.difficultyReason: Recover an individual share from a percentage, then use the ratio to recover the original total.

content.prompt: Bobbie and Emily share some money in the ratio $2:5$. Bobbie gives $20\%$ of her share to Sven. Sven receives $\$24$. Work out the original amount of money that was shared.

answer.worked:
Find Bobbie’s original share using the unitary method.
$$\begin{align*}
20\%&=\$24\\
1\%&=\$24\div20=\$1.20\\
100\%&=\$1.20\times100=\$120
\end{align*}$$
Bobbie’s share represents 2 ratio parts. The total represents $2+5=7$ parts.
$$\begin{align*}
2\text{ parts}&=\$120\\
1\text{ part}&=\$120\div2=\$60\\
7\text{ parts}&=\$60\times7=\$420
\end{align*}$$
The original amount shared was $\$420$.
